item.title: Structurist Creative Research Fellowship (4th round)
item.description:
Organisation: University of Saskatchewan Art Galleries and Collection

Location: Saskatoon, Canada (travel and accommodation covered for the Saskatoon component). Open internationally, any career stage.

Award: Project budget up to CAD 20,000, plus travel and accommodation for the Saskatoon research component. No application fee.

Duration: Research-creation fellowship around The Structurist journal archive.

Deadline: 31 Aug 2026

The University of Saskatchewan Art Galleries offer the Structurist Creative Research Fellowship, supporting art-and-science research-creation engaging The Structurist, the art and architecture journal published at the university from 1960 to 2010. The fellowship provides a project budget of up to CAD 20,000 plus travel and accommodation for the Saskatoon component. Open internationally at any career stage. Deadline 31 August 2026.
